name: Charm Animal
body:
Source PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 254
School enchantment (charm) [mind-affecting]; Level druid 1, hunter 1, psychic 1, ranger 1, shaman 1
Casting
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S
Effect
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one animal
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes
Description
This spell functions like charm person, except that it affects a creature of the animal type.
